info.title: Spectra Demo API - E-Commerce Platform
info.description: A comprehensive REST API built with Node.js and Express for an e-commerce platform. Features user management, product catalog, orders, reviews, shopping cart, wishlists, coupons, and more. All data is stored in-memory for testing purposes.

get.description: Retrieve a paginated list of users with optional filtering

adjustment.description: Positive to add, negative to subtract

parameters.name: parentId
parameters.description: Filter by parent (use 'null' for root categories)

201.description: Review created (auto-verified if user purchased product)

400.description: Invalid coupon (expired, limit reached, min purchase not met)

post.description: Upload a single image file using multipart/form-data. Supported formats: JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP. Max size: 5MB.
Upload multiple image files (up to 5) using multipart/form-data. Supported formats: JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP. Max size: 5MB per file.
Upload profile data with avatar, cover image, and gallery images using multipart/form-data. Demonstrates mixed text and file fields.
Upload an image for a specific product. Requires admin or manager role.

get.description: Get a paginated list of uploaded files. Non-admin users only see their own files.
Get information about a specific uploaded file. Users can only view their own files unless admin.

delete.description: Delete an uploaded file. Users can only delete their own files unless admin.

path.description: URL path to access the file

uploadedBy.description: User ID who uploaded the file
